author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Playstation 4 and 5 adding an online DRM that requires you to post online every 30 days or lose access to your games. Is this even true? Let's try to get to the facts and see just how screwed the gamers are here. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: So Playstation Added DRM And It's Awful...
